exposes_summary: trigger, countdown, garage_door_contact, run_time, open_alarm_time, status

exposes.name: Trigger
exposes.description: Request door to close (= false) or open (= true), will not pulse output if contact shows door is already in requested state.

exposes.name: Countdown
exposes.description: Countdown to trigger door movement after a certain time, will pulse output in all cases.

exposes.name: Garage door contact
exposes.description: Indicates if the garage door contact is closed (= true) or open (= false).

exposes.name: Run time
exposes.description: Configure the time to wait for the door contact status to change before triggering a run time alarm.

exposes.name: Open alarm time
exposes.description: Configure the amount of time the door may be open before an open time alarm is triggered.

exposes.name: Status
exposes.description: Indicates run time alarm, door open alarm or normal status, will not return to normal until door is triggered again.
